25-66-02B.txt:
FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS
      No restrictions.
   FLIGHT CREW
      Flight crew brief the cabin crew on incomplete, missing or inoperative Supplementary Life Raft,
      passenger distribution and modified cabin safety procedures.
      In case that there is not an inoperative Cabin Door, a maximum of 165 persons including the flight
      crew and cabin crew are carried.






   In case that there is an inoperative Cabin Door, a maximum of people including the flight crew and
   cabin crew comes from Passenger seats minus Blocked seats as directed in MEL Item 52-10-01
   minus 55 people.
   For example, No. 1 Door is inoperative at A/C with 195 passenger seats for extended overwater
   flight. A maximum of people including flight crew and cabin crew are 46 seats which comes from
   195 (Passenger seats) minus 94 (Blocked seats as MEL Item 52-10-01 applied) minus 55.
